title: Without a Min, Shop supplies starts at $0.00
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer, with no Min shop supplies charge, with one asset, asset 1.
  • Make sure the test location has a shop supplies percentage set.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Work Order.
  2. Pick customer A.
  3. Pick asset 1.
  4. Click Save in the New Work Order window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Work Order window opens.

Step 2:

  • The "Internal" badge shows.

Step 3:

  • Asset 1 is picked.

Step 4:

  • "Shop supplies" reads $0.00: the location's percentage does not apply.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11767 (Story 10, Shop supplies on internal and no-charge work orders)

  • S10-R1: “An internal or no-charge work order carries one field "Shop supplies" (a dollar amount) in the block where a billable work order shows its totals. It is set when the work order becomes internal or no charge: the customer's Min shop supplies charge from the customer profile, or $0.00 when none is set. The percentage rule and the location percentage do not apply. On a flagged customer, Edit Customer accepts the Min without a shop supplies percentage (today Min is disabled until a percentage is entered); a percentage, if set, never applies to internal or no-charge work orders.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
